fusions.name: Inscribed Dent
fusions.desc: A blow that stamps a glyph into the target, dealing 13 damage, leaving it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds and with a 50% chance of [Muddled] for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Gavel Word
fusions.desc: Speaks a word and slams the ground, dealing 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and ignoring resistances.

fusions.name: Second Word
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting.

fusions.name: Rote Swing
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 7% sooner. Your armour rises by 5%.
